name: bottom-line
description: While Claude works, hide its text and show a live plan with the skills and images it uses; when it finishes, show only the summary. Keeps a history of past tasks.

hideText.title: Hide Claude's text while it works
hideText.description: Off: Claude's messages and tool steps show as usual; the list still shows above the prompt.

skillsLine.title: Skills line
skillsLine.description: Show the skills Claude uses in the list.

imagesRow.title: Images row
imagesRow.description: Show thumbnails of the pictures in play in the list.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: Show the helpers (subagents) and background commands under the step that started them.

keepFinished.title: Keep the finished list
keepFinished.description: Off: the list goes away as soon as Claude finishes, instead of staying until your next prompt.
